lutheran-church-our-savior-jacksonville-.assessment: Lutheran Church of Our Savior is the ELCA Lutheran congregation on Lejeune Boulevard — the main road between downtown Jacksonville NC and Camp Lejeune. The pastor, Mike Lang, is male, and the congregation likely contains many sincere Christians (including military families). But the denominational frame is the issue. ELCA's 2009 ChurchWide Assembly formally authorized the ordination of partnered same-sex clergy and the blessing of same-sex relationships; subsequent assemblies expanded that posture. ELCA has ordained women at all levels (including bishops) since 1970. The homepage greeting — "ALL are welcome" with open communion ("Holy Communion is available to all baptized Christians") — is consistent with the inclusive/welcoming identity ELCA has cultivated. This is institutional drift from biblical sexual ethics. Per MOOP rubric, ELCA congregations are flagged RED at the denominational level regardless of local pastor or local rhetorical conservatism. If Adam visited a Lutheran church near MCAS New River during V-22 training, this is the most visible Lutheran congregation on the Camp Lejeune corridor. Not recommended for MOOP-aligned theological convictions.

score_notes.christology: ELCA confesses the Trinitarian creeds (Apostles, Nicene, Athanasian) on paper, but doctrinal discipline at the denominational level has eroded; local christology presumed orthodox but not stated on homepage.
score_notes.scripture: ELCA "Human Sexuality: Gift and Trust" (2009 social statement) and subsequent practice formally subordinate biblical sexual ethics to lived experience. Functional rejection of Scripture's authority on sexuality.
score_notes.gender: ELCA ordains women at all levels including bishops since 1970; "Lutheran Church of Our Savior" with male Pastor Mike Lang does not change the denominational position. ELCA-defining: egalitarian.
score_notes.leadership: Male pastor here, but ELCA polity ordains women bishops/pastors at all levels; church accountable to NC Synod under an ELCA hierarchy that fully affirms women in pastoral office.
score_notes.soteriology: Lutheran confessional soteriology (sola fide) presumed denominationally; ELCA "Joint Declaration on Justification" (1999) ecumenical agreement with Rome adds complexity. Local statement not provided.
score_notes.cultural: ELCA is institutionally on the LGBTQ-affirming, progressive side of mainline Protestantism; "ALL are welcome" homepage language consistent with ELCA welcoming/inclusive identity. "Holy Communion is available to all baptized Christians" — open communion.
score_notes.preaching: Lectionary-based liturgical preaching presumed; specific style not documented on homepage.
score_notes.mission: Faith Formation programming + food pantry mentioned; Great Commission framing not visible. Community-service oriented per mainline mainline pattern.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No men's ministry mentioned on homepage. Faith Formation is intergenerational rather than gender-specific.
score_notes.denominational: ELCA — 2009 ChurchWide Assembly authorized ordination of partnered same-sex clergy and same-sex marriage rites; reaffirmed and expanded in subsequent assemblies. RED per MOOP rubric (denominational drift).
